# SkillsFuture for Digital Workplace - SupportGoWhere

SkillsFuture for Digital Workplace

Share link

Equips Singapore Citizen adults with essential digital skills for the evolving digital economy.

SCHEME HIGHLIGHTS

- Develop a deep understanding of critical digital competencies for the evolving economy
- Safely navigate technology-rich environments with cybersecurity awareness
- Master various digital tools, including nationally recognized platforms, for strategic data utilization

Expand all sections

About this support

- Navigate technology-rich environments with awareness of cybersecurity risks, ensuring secure work practices

- Acquire proficiency in diverse digital applications and tools, including nationally recognized platforms, while understanding the strategic use of data and information

  - Gain insights into essential jobs and digital skills needed in today's and tomorrow's digital economy

Who is this for?

- Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident

- Employers can tap on SFDW2.0 to equip their employees with the necessary aptitudes and skills


How to apply?

Choose a programme partner and contact them directly:

- Ascendo Academy Pte Ltd: Email [sdfw@ascendo.edu.sg](mailto:sdfw@ascendo.edu.sg) or call [+65 8383 2908](tel:83832908)

- Capelle Academy Pte Ltd: Email [contactus@capelleconsulting.com](mailto:contactus@capelleconsulting.com) or call [+65 6325 4982](tel:63254982)

- James Cook Institute Pte Ltd: Email [enquiry@jci.edu.sg](mailto:enquiry@jci.edu.sg), call [+65 6737 5761](tel:67375761), or WhatsApp +65 8767 0614

- Eduquest International Institute Pte. Ltd.: Email [info@eduquest.sg](mailto:info@eduquest.sg) or call [+65 6338 7151](tel:63387151)

- NTUC LearningHub Pte Ltd: For individual enquiries, email [sales@ntuclearninghub.com](mailto:sales@ntuclearninghub.com) or WhatsApp +65 8488 5482. For corporate enquiries, email [corpsales@ntuclearninghub.com](mailto:corpsales@ntuclearninghub.com)

- Nanyang Polytechnic: Visit [their website](https://www.nyp.edu.sg/) for more information

- Singapore Chinese Chamber Institute of Business: Email [enquiry@scciob.edu.sg](mailto:enquiry@scciob.edu.sg) or call [+65 6505 3898](tel:65053898) / [+65 6334 1080](tel:63341080)

- Singapore National Employers Federation: Email [christopher\_oh@snef.org.sg](mailto:christopher_oh@snef.org.sg) or call [+65 6827 6919](tel:68276919)
